title: Sebastian and the Postcard
author: Juniper Ishikawa
blurb: Rafael Sandoval, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
